applies_to: Public & private owners and operators of personal databases
key_requirements: Consent, registration of personal databases, local storage of Uzbek citizens' data, data subject rights
enforcement_authority: State Personalization Center under the Cabinet of Ministers
penalties_range: Administrative fines up to 50 base values; criminal liability for repeat offences
exemptions: Household use; state secrets; defence & national security information
notes: Localization rule (2021) narrowed by Mar 2026 amendment; adequacy list of 49 countries set Jul 2026
